chunks: “The minimum du'a that suffices you after the obligatory prayer is that you say: ‘O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad. O Allah, we ask You for every good encompassed by Your knowledge, and we seek refuge in You from every evil encompassed by Your knowledge. O Allah, we ask You for Your well-being in all of our affairs, all of them, and we seek refuge in You from the disgrace of this world and the punishment of the Hereafter.’”

key_terms.شَرٍّ: every evil from which refuge is sought

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum du'a to recite after the obligatory prayer according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a concise du'a to be recited after the obligatory prayers. It combines salawat upon Muhammad and آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ, asking Allah for all good, seeking refuge from all evil, requesting well-being in all matters, and protection from worldly disgrace and the punishment of the Hereafter.
